heading: Annual report
lead: The corporation shall submit an annual report to Congress on the activities of the corporation during the prior fiscal year.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 4030736:207.July 1, 1946, ch. 527, § 7, 60 Stat. 347.

Termination of Reporting RequirementsFor termination, effective May 15, 2000, of reporting provisions in this section, see section 3003 of Pub. L. 104–66, set out as a note under section 1113 of Title 31, Money and Finance, and page 198 of House Document No. 103–7.
